exposure: laparoscopic transabdominal cerclage with a needle-free technique
cohort: The study included 11 high-risk women with cervical incompetence who had experienced previous transvaginal cerclage (TVC) failure or were not eligible for TVC.
finding: The needle-free laparoscopic transabdominal cerclage was found to be a safe and effective treatment option for high-risk women with cervical incompetence, yielding good obstetric results without increased perioperative morbidity.
